purpose: Phase 1D multi-week time-travel dry run (operational validation on BURNED weeks; not a holdout; not used for tuning)
selection_rule: one early-season, one mid-season and one late-season 2025 week chosen by fixed rule BEFORE any of their runs: week 4 (early), week 11 (mid; not week 10, which was already the Phase 1C dry-run week), week 16 (late; holiday-schedule stress); plus 2026 weeks 1, 2 and 3 (all remaining burned 2026 weeks)
not_allowed: replacing or adding a week after seeing any operational or accuracy output of these runs
